title: Lift partial-output weights to a uniform original-input population
statement: Select a completed output M with probability w(M)/N,where w(M) is its actual original source-fiber population,then sample uniformly within that fiber. The reported completed adapter gives each accepted original assignment probability1/N;missing matrix entries are deterministic functions of the same inputs,not independent new variables.
